# BASMA | بصمة (@basma.llb) — 3D CNC Wood Carving & Automotive Wall Art Studio

> Basma (بصمة | @basma.llb) is a specialized Lebanese artisan & precision CNC woodworking studio crafting deep 3D solid hardwood relief carvings and sleek matte-black layered automotive & gaming wall silhouettes.

## Studio Overview
- **Brand Name:** BASMA | بصمة
- **Instagram Handle:** [@basma.llb](https://www.instagram.com/basma.llb)
- **Direct WhatsApp Concierge:** https://wa.me/96170360671 (+961 70 360 671)
- **Email:** mailto:concierge@basma-studio.com
- **Origin:** Beirut, Lebanon (Worldwide Express Shipping & Local Cash on Delivery)
- **Core Craftsmanship:**
  1. **Drive The Vibe (Matte-Black Layered Wood Silhouettes):** Precision CNC/laser-routed 15mm–18mm high-density wood wall cutouts finished in 0%-glare architectural matte carbon black with floating wall standoffs.
  2. **3D Wood Design (Deep CNC Relief Carvings):** Multi-axis 0.1mm tolerance Z-depth relief sculptures carved into kiln-dried solid walnut, natural oak, and aged Lebanese cedar, hand-sanded to 400-grit and sealed with organic beeswax-linseed oil.

## Interactive Studio Configurators
- **Wall Vibe & Lighting Simulator (`/#wall-vibe-studio`):** Preview pieces on Warm Sunlit Plaster, Matte Charcoal Slate, Natural Wood Slats, or Industrial Loft Brick under Natural Daylight or Warm Night Spotlight, with click-and-drag wall placement.
- **Live Size & Price Calculator (`/#size-price-guide`):** Real-time 30cm–120cm scale visualizer above a reference 210cm sofa.
  - Matte Cutout Formula: `Base $28 + ($0.95 × Width_cm)`
  - 3D CNC Relief Formula: `Base $45 + ($1.45 × Width_cm)`
- **“Carve Your Own” Custom Order Studio (`/#custom-configurator`):** Upload any car, portrait, or emblem photo for real-time HTML5 Canvas 3D wood relief or matte-black stencil simulation, custom wood species selection (Oak, Walnut, Cedar, Carbon Black), custom dimensions, and draggable laser-engraved dedication text.

## Ordering & Fulfillment Workflow
- Customers can add catalog or bespoke items to the slide-over order bag or send a structured custom specification sheet directly via WhatsApp (`https://wa.me/96170360671`).
- Every custom commission includes a 3D digital proof for approval prior to CNC routing.
- Payment via Cash on Delivery (COD) in Lebanon and express courier delivery internationally.
